name: When should I consider replacing my windows?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider replacing my windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider replacing your windows if you notice drafts, condensation between panes, difficulty operating them, increased energy bills, or visible damage like rot or warping. New windows can also significantly improve your home's curb appeal, noise reduction, and overall comfort, making it a worthwhile upgrade even without major issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider replacing windows if you notice drafts, condensation, difficulty operating them, high energy bills, or visible damage. New windows also improve home value and comfort.
